articles.title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen

The agentic AI capabilities built into operating systems that analyze on-screen information to learn more about the user are "undermining Signal's ability to independently guarantee privacy," Signal president […]

items.title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
items.summary: AI实验室Anthropic上周四在纳斯达克上市，其安全优先策略引发外界关注。
items.why_it_matters: 上市后资本压力可能影响其长期安全投入与研发方向的选择。

items.title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
items.summary: Signal限制安卓和iOS截图功能以阻止Gemini等AI读取用户消息数据。
items.why_it_matters: 此举旨在维护隐私承诺，但可能削弱系统级AI助手的数据获取能力。

items.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
items.summary: 数学家Alpöge声称借助Claude证明了黎曼猜想，该成果目前尚待验证。
items.why_it_matters: 若证实将标志AI在数学领域取得突破性进展，改变科研范式。

items.title: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
items.summary: 联合国代表未能就自主武器规则达成一致，仅同意开始讨论相关选项。
items.why_it_matters: 监管僵局可能导致致命性自主武器系统的部署缺乏国际约束力。

items.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
items.summary: 特朗普威胁对在美国境外建设AI数据中心的企业征收巨额税收措施。
items.why_it_matters: 该政策可能迫使企业回流本土，增加全球AI基础设施运营成本。
